SELECT a1.s, a0.vc FROM t2 a0, t2 a1 WHERE a0.vc = a1.ch AND a0.d38b IS NOT NULL AND a0.id IN (SELECT s0.id FROM t2 s0) AND a0.vc = a0.ch ORDER BY (SELECT MIN(COALESCE(2, -1)) FROM t1 s1) LIMIT 10

fail_closed_leaks.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a0.y), SUM((a1.big * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)), (a1.flag % 2) FROM t2 a0 CROSS JOIN t3 a1 WHERE d38a = 1.2345678901234568e27 AND (a0.s = 'ba' OR a1.s > 'a') AND a1.id = a0.y GROUP BY 3 ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE a1.s WHEN 'a' THEN 1 WHEN 'b' THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) ASC

SELECT CAST(a1.s AS VARCHAR), SUM((2.00 * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t0 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.n = a1.t1_id WHERE a1.big = 9007199254740992e0 AND CAST(a1.big AS DOUBLE) = CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY CAST(a1.s AS VARCHAR) HAVING CAST(a1.s AS VARCHAR) = '' AND COUNT(*) > 0 ORDER BY SUM((2.00 * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) DESC
SELECT AVG((a0.id * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) AS c5 FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.y IS NULL AND a0.d38b = 5e0 ORDER BY AVG((a0.id * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT SUM((1 % 2)) AS c1, (1 / SUM((CAST(CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE) AS DECIMAL(10,2)) * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001))), MAX(a0.name) AS "N" FROM t1 a0 JOIN t4 a1 ON a0.t0_id = a1.t3_id WHERE a0.d38b = 1.2345678901234568e27 AND a0.d38b = 5e0
SELECT SUM((ROUND(2.00, 1) * BIGINT '3'::REAL)), a0.s, MAX(GREATEST(2, a0.id)) FILTER (WHERE a0.id = a0.flag) FROM t0 a0 GROUP BY a0.s ORDER BY (3) NULLS LAST LIMIT 0 OFFSET 1

SELECT (a0.big % 2) AS c3, SUM((0.50 * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS big FROM t2 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.big = a1.t1_id WHERE a1.big = a1.ch AND a0.ch = 'ab' GROUP BY (a0.big % 2) ORDER BY "BIG" ASC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2

SELECT AVG((ABS(a0.d38b) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS w FROM t1 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.id = a1.w WHERE a1.u = a0.ch AND a1.w BETWEEN 2 AND 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.y = a0.id)

SELECT flag, AVG((a0.big * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS "D", COALESCE(MAX(FALSE), FALSE) AS "C2" FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.d38a > 5 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT (a0.d38a * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) ASC, flag DESC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2

SELECT (SELECT SUM((s0.w * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.name = a0.y), a1.t1_id FROM t3 a0 CROSS JOIN t2 a1 WHERE a1.tz NOT IN (TIMESTAMPTZ '2018-03-11 07:30:00+00', TIMESTAMPTZ '2018-11-04 06:30:00+00') ORDER BY a1.name DESC

SELECT a1.name FROM t5 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.big = a1.id JOIN t5 a2 ON a0.v = a2.v WHERE (a1.w = a2.s OR a1.vc = 'aB') AND a2.vc = a0.vc AND a2.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY (SELECT AVG((s * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t5 s0 WHERE s0.t1_id = a0.x) DESC LIMIT 0 OFFSET 1

SELECT a0.t0_id, ub AS x, (SELECT MIN((s0.x + 30)) FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.t2_id = a0.big) FROM t1 a0 WHERE (a0.big = 1e0 OR a0.y = CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)) ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t1 s1) ASC, (SELECT SUM((-1.50 * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) FROM t1 s2) LIMIT 1

SELECT a0.d38b AS vc, a0.x AS d38a, SUM((a2.d38a * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) AS "W" FROM t2 a0 CROSS JOIN t1 a1, t0 a2 WHERE a1.big = a2.id AND a2.d38a = 1.2345678901234568e27 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.id = a1.t0_id) AND a1.big = 9007199254740994 GROUP BY a0.d38b, a0.x ORDER BY 2 LIMIT 1
SELECT AVG((TRY_CAST(a0.vc AS INTEGER) * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.dbl53 = a0.big AND a0.d38b = 1234567890123456789012345678.5000000000 AND a0.x = TRUE

SELECT DISTINCT a0.d38a, SUM((a2.d38a * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS d38b FROM t1 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.ts = a1.tz JOIN t0 a2 ON a1.code < a2.name WHERE a2.dbl53 = a0.y AND a0.id = 2 AND a0.ch = a1.vc GROUP BY 1 HAVING a0.d38a IS NULL LIMIT 5
SELECT AVG((a1.d38b * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t3 a0 CROSS JOIN t2 a1 JOIN t5 a2 ON a1.tz = a2.ts WHERE a1.ts = a0.tz AND a1.vc = a2.t2_id

SELECT d38a FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.n = 10 ORDER BY (SELECT MIN(s0.s) FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.code = a0.ch) ASC, a0.tz DESC NULLS LAST, (SELECT AVG((s1.big * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t0 s1) LIMIT 3
SELECT SUM((a1.id * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)), SUM(a0.d38a) FROM t0 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.ch = a1.vc WHERE a0.d38a = 5e0 GROUP BY CAST(a1.d AS VARCHAR)
SELECT a0.n FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.amt = CAST('0.0' AS DOUBLE) AND a0.big = 9.007199254740993e15 AND a0.big = 1e0 ORDER BY 1 ASC, (SELECT SUM((s0.ub * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t1 s0), (1) DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN SUM((a0.ub * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE FALSE = FALSE) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.y = CAST('0.0' AS DOUBLE) AND (big = a0.t1_id OR a0.y = a0.d) GROUP BY a0.t1_id, CAST(a0.y AS VARCHAR) HAVING a0.t1_id IS NULL ORDER BY 1 ASC, 1 ASC, 1 DESC

SELECT (a1.id % 2), MAX(2.00) FROM t3 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.s = a1.vc WHERE a0.s = 'ba' AND a1.v <> CAST('2.0' AS DOUBLE) GROUP BY 1, a0.y HAVING SUM((a0.x * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) = CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE) ORDER BY (1) LIMIT 2

SELECT a1.s FROM t3 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.ch = a1.flag JOIN t1 a2 ON a1.vc = a2.ch WHERE a0.s >= (SELECT s0.w FROM t4 s0 WHERE s0.y = a0.ch) AND a1.ch = a2.vc ORDER BY (1), a0.big, (SELECT AVG((s1.big * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t3 s1 WHERE s1.s = a1.v) DESC

SELECT (SELECT MIN((d38a <> s0.d38a)) FROM t0 s0 WHERE s0.dbl53 = a1.v) AS "UB", (SELECT AVG((s1.d38b * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t2 s1 WHERE s1.t1_id = a0.id), a0.id AS x FROM t1 a0 JOIN t4 a1 ON a0.id = a1.t1_id JOIN t0 a2 ON a0.vc = a2.ch

SELECT SUM((a1.flag * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)), (a0.t2_id % 2), MAX(TRIM(a1.amt)) FROM t3 a0, t1 a1 WHERE a0.ch < a1.ch AND a1.vc = 'a' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t4 s0 WHERE s0.id = a0.id AND t1_id = 9007199254740992e0) AND a0.vc BETWEEN 'b' AND '01' GROUP BY (a0.t2_id % 2) HAVING (a0.t2_id % 2) IS NULL AND COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY (a0.t2_id % 2), (a0.t2_id % 2) NULLS LAST LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM((a1.t0_id * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END FROM t1 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.s = a1.vc GROUP BY (a0.id % 2) ORDER BY 1 NULLS LAST
SELECT (a0.ub % 2) AS id, AVG((0.50 * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)), SUM(0.00) FROM t1 a0 WHERE a0.ts = a0.tz GROUP BY (a0.ub % 2) ORDER BY id DESC NULLS FIRST

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a2.flag)), CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)), SUM((a1.d38a * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)), (1 / MAX((a1.d38a % 0.75))) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t2 a1 ON a0.ts = a1.tz JOIN t1 a2 ON a0.ts = a2.tz WHERE a1.ub = a2.vc OFFSET 1

SELECT SUM((STRPOS(a2.s, 'a') * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS "TZ", a2.tz, MAX((a1.n IS NULL)) FROM t2 a0, t1 a1 JOIN t2 a2 ON a0.tz = a2.ts WHERE a0.tz <= a1.tz AND a0.tz = a0.ts AND (a1.u <> 'bb' OR a1.u = a2.id) AND a0.ts = a0.tz GROUP BY a2.tz, CAST(a0.tz AS DATE) HAVING a2.tz IS NULL AND CAST(a0.tz AS DATE) IS NULL ORDER BY 3 NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(CAST('-0.0' AS DOUBLE)), SUM((a0.y * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.w NOT IN (-2, -2)

SELECT CASE WHEN AVG((ROUND(a1.name, 0) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) > 1 THEN 'hi' ELSE 'lo' END AS "NAME", COUNT(DISTINCT a1.id) AS ub, COALESCE(MAX(COALESCE(a1.s, 'B')), '1') FROM t1 a0 JOIN t4 a1 ON a0.id = a1.t1_id WHERE a1.name = a1.big
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CAST(FLOOR(a0.d38b) AS INTEGER)) AS VARCHAR) AS id, AVG((-a0.id::DECIMAL(10,2) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)), COUNT(*) AS dbl53 FROM t0 a0
SELECT SUM((-1 * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FILTER (WHERE a0.d38a = 12345678901234567890123456789012345679) FROM t0 a0 LIMIT 0

SELECT a0.big AS c3 FROM t0 a0 WHERE (a0.big = 18446744073709551615e0 OR name = 'a') AND a0.big = 0 AND a0.id IN (1, 8) ORDER BY (SELECT AVG((s0.id * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) FROM t2 s0 WHERE s0.v = a0.name) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((d38b * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)), CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE)) FROM t2 a0 WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.vc = a0.s AND s0.dbl53 = CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE))

SELECT (MIN((a0.t0_id * 1e-1)) + 1), AVG((a0.v * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS "AMT" FROM t4 a0 WHERE a0.amt NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT s0.s FROM t2 s0 WHERE n = 'B') AND a0.big IN (SELECT s1.id FROM t0 s1) AND a0.n = 6 GROUP BY a0.n HAVING MIN(3) = 0 AND COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY MAX((0.00 * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) ASC NULLS LAST, 2 ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 2

SELECT a0.name, AVG(NULLIF(a0.d38b, 0.00)) AS w, a0.w, AVG(((a0.d38b + a0.id) * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) AS "D38A" FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.n = a0.w GROUP BY a0.w, a0.name HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY a0.w ASC
SELECT (MAX(a0.d) + 1), AVG((a1.v * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)), a0.big, (a0.big + 1) AS "TS" FROM t0 a0, t3 a1 WHERE a0.id = a1.v GROUP BY a0.big
SELECT SUM((a1.v * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t1 a0 JOIN t0 a1 ON a0.tz = a1.ts, t0 a2 WHERE a2.dbl53 = a1.d38a AND a1.big = 9007199254740992e0 LIMIT 5 OFFSET 5
SELECT SUM((1.25 * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)), a1.ch, (a0.n % 2) FROM t1 a0, t1 a1 WHERE a1.tz = a0.ts GROUP BY 3, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC, MAX(a0.amt) ASC NULLS LAST
SELECT MIN(a0.d), (1 / SUM((LENGTH(a1.ch) * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE))) FROM t1 a0 CROSS JOIN t1 a1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS vc, SUM((v * INTEGER '2'::DOUBLE)) AS "V" FROM t0 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.ts = a1.tz WHERE (a1.ch IS NOT NULL) = TRUE AND a0.vc = a1.ch AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t1 s0 WHERE s0.name = a0.ub) ORDER BY "VC" LIMIT 2
SELECT ROUND(SUM(LEAST(a1.d38a, a0.d38a)), 1), SUM((-1 * 0.1000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) AS n FROM t3 a0 JOIN t3 a1 ON a0.ch = a1.vc WHERE a1.vc = a0.ch

SELECT CAST(a0.tz AS DATE) AS "Mixed Case", MAX(a0.flag) FROM t4 a0, t1 a1 WHERE a1.dbl53 >= (SELECT SUM((s0.d38a * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t3 s0 WHERE s0.big = a0.id) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY CAST(a0.tz AS DATE) DESC NULLS FIRST, "Mixed Case" DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT (a1.amt % 2), SUM((0 * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)) AS w FROM t0 a0, t1 a1 JOIN t3 a2 ON a0.tz = a2.ts WHERE a1.ub = 18446744073709551615e0 GROUP BY (a1.amt % 2) ORDER BY 2 ASC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 5
SELECT MIN(ROUND(CAST('1.5' AS DOUBLE), 1)), AVG((TRY_CAST('aB' AS INTEGER) * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) FROM t0 a0

SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS VARCHAR), a0.code, SUM(a1.x) FROM t3 a0 JOIN t1 a1 ON a0.ch = a1.vc WHERE a0.name = a1.u GROUP BY (a1.flag * 2), a0.code HAVING SUM((a1.big * DECIMAL '1.25'::FLOAT)) <= CAST('0.0' AS DOUBLE) ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(a0.d38a) AS c5, AVG(((a0.d38a * a0.id) * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FROM t0 a0 WHERE a0.ts = a0.tz AND a0.big = 18446744073709551615e0 AND a0.ts = a0.tz

SELECT a1.d38a AS "FLAG", COALESCE((a1.d38a * t0_id), 1.25), a1.t0_id FROM t5 a0 JOIN t4 a1 ON a0.n = a1.v WHERE a0.s <= 'aB' AND a1.ts = a0.tz AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM t4 s0 WHERE s0.id = a0.t4_id) ORDER BY (SELECT AVG((GREATEST(s1.ub, s1.big) * BIGINT '3'::REAL)) FILTER (WHERE s1.ub = 18446744073709551614) FROM t0 s1 WHERE s1.x = a0.n) DESC, +a1.d38b DESC NULLS FIRST
SELECT COUNT(*) AS c1, SUM((CAST(a0.flag AS INTEGER) * DECIMAL '0.1'::DOUBLE)), COUNT(*) FROM t3 a0 WHERE a0.ub = 1e0 LIMIT 5

SELECT LOWER(a2.x), (1 / MAX((a2.ub * 2.5e0))), a2.x AS "AMT" FROM t1 a0 CROSS JOIN t1 a1, t2 a2 GROUP BY a2.x HAVING MAX(a2.d) = TRUE AND a2.x IS NULL ORDER BY SUM((a1.id * 100000000000000000000000000000000000000001)) NULLS LAST, 1
